'''Sord Montok''' was a transport company active during the height of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They were best known for the transport of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], primarily [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] as the [[Species/Legends|species]] had an ancient rivalry which the slavers could use to occupy the slave with fighting among themselves rather than attempting to escape. The company's main [[Transport/Legends|transport ship]], the [[Sord Montok (starship)|''Sord Montok'']], was named for the company itself.<ref name="BtDF" />

After picking up the Wookiee slave [[Reerookachuck]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], he caused a riot enabling him to escape. As a result, the [[Unidentified Sord Montok CEO|Sord Montok CEO]] placed a sixty-five thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the Wookiee to make an example of him and preserve the corporation's image.<ref name="BtDF" />
